stories.headline: PLS Group Limited: Q3 2026 Earnings Call on Apr 23, 2026 - Transcript
stories.summary: Management blamed cyclone-related congestion at Port Hedland for March-quarter sales of 195.7kt, which were 16% lower QoQ and about 37kt below production of 232.4kt; the inventory was to be shipped in the June quarter.
stories.evidence: Yeah, just look, the sales and the production just don't match. It was just the congestion around that cyclone at Port Hedland.

stories.evidence: The company's "soft" third quarter sales will be unwound into the fourth quarter's resilient price environment

stories.headline: PLS Shares Hit Fresh All-Time-High as Lithium Recovery Accelerates

stories.evidence: flagging some expected upward pressure on unit costs in the June quarter due to wet-season conditions and preparation work for the Ngungaju restart

stories.headline: PLS Group Limited: Q4 2026 Earnings Call on Jul 29, 2026 - Report
stories.summary: June-quarter FOB unit cost rose about 18% QoQ to A$616/t (from A$520/t), and CIF rose 15% to A$845/t; the company attributed the rise to higher diesel prices during the Middle East conflict and Ngungaju restart costs.
stories.evidence: Unit operating cost (FOB) increased to $616/t (US$437/t) compared to prior Quarter driven by higher diesel prices and Ngungaju plant restart costs.

stories.headline: PLS Group Limited: Q4 2026 Earnings Call on Jul 29, 2026 - Report
stories.summary: FY27 guidance puts FOB unit cost at A$575-625/t (FY26 actual A$569/t, FY26 guidance A$560-600/t) because of higher-cost Ngungaju tonnes, and capex at A$620-685M (FY26 A$328M), with sustaining capex also higher.
stories.evidence: Unit operating costs (FOB) are expected to marginally increase to between $575-$625/t due to higher relative operating costs from the Ngungaju plant

stories.headline: PLS Group Limited: Q4 2026 Earnings Call on Jul 29, 2026 - Report
stories.summary: In May, vessel wait times at Port Hedland rose materially (berth maintenance, fuel and ammonium nitrate shipments given priority, seasonal traffic), which hurt operating efficiency; June-quarter sales volumes were not affected.
stories.evidence: operational efficiency was affected during the month of May as vessel wait times increased materially at Port Hedland
